title: ASP2397 Is a Novel Natural Compound That Exhibits Rapid and Potent Fungicidal Activity against Aspergillus Species through a Specific Transporter
abstract: Current therapies against invasive pulmonary aspergillosis (IPA) have a limited cure rate. Given that a delay in treatment initiation may be fatal, a new drug with rapid-onset and potent fungicidal activity is needed. The novel cyclic hexapeptide ASP2397 (currently known as VL-2397) exhibited antifungal activity against             Aspergillus fumigatus             (including azole-sensitive and azole-resistant isolates),             A. terreus             , and             A. flavus             at an MIC range of 1 to 4 μg/ml in human serum.
